title: Satwik-Chirag Reflect on China Masters Win, Eye Asian Games Defence
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair discusses their recent BWF Super 750 title victory and future goals.
summary: India's star men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, shared insights into their strategy after winning the China Masters, emphasizing their strong defence and patient attack. The duo is now focused on defending their Asian Games title.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance coaching standards for Indian badminton coaches at key National Centers of Excellence.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has scheduled a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, focusing on developing coaching expertise across the country.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The new regulations will govern one of India's premier domestic team events, impacting state associations and players nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating state teams.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on developing junior players.

title: World Junior Championships 2026 Selection Trials List Released
indian_angle: This announcement details the players qualified for the final selection trials to represent India at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI has published the eligibility criteria and the list of players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt, marking a key step in forming the Indian junior squad.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will affect all young Indian badminton players competing in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, effective immediately.
